// @path: src/app/ops/schools/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-REQUIRE-OPERATOR
// An inline Server Action compiles to its own POST endpoint with its own action
// id, reachable with a crafted request. The guard on the page that rendered it
// is a guard on an ancestor, which is exactly what this rule exists to refuse.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { freezeSchool } from "@/lib/ops/operations";

export default async function OpsSchools({ schoolId }) {
  await requireOperator();
  async function freeze(formData) {
    "use server";
    return freezeSchool(schoolId, formData.get("reason"));
  }
  return <form action={freeze} />;
}
